26 ## The Elegance Law (locked by John — binding on this skill)
27 
28 Canonical text: `Skill Foundry/ELEGANCE.md`. Applies to ANY agent running this
29 skill on ANY host. If this block and a longer procedure below disagree, this
30 block wins.
31 
32 1. **Approvals are ≤200 words** — what changes in his world, the recommendation,
33    the one thing that gets worse. The artifact stays on disk and is named, not
34    pasted. An approval obtained with a longer block is VOID.
35 2. **Summaries are ≤150 words** — goal in one line, done / not done, ≤3 findings
36    ranked by consequence, the single next decision. Never rounds, waves, seats,
37    stamps, gate counts, or file inventories.
38 3. **Default to the lightest band, without asking.** A heavier tier requires the
39    first status line to NAME its trigger: irreversible or externally visible,
40    inputs unconverged, a prior failure in this exact area, or he asked for it.
41 4. **Needed-because line.** Any element he did not request carries one line:
42    "Needed because ___; dropping it costs ___." No line, no element.
43 5. **Show a cut.** ONE dry round ends a review loop — never a streak. Every plan
44    names something it removed; "nothing cut" is said aloud.
45 
46 **THE VERIFICATION LAW** (added 2026-08-15 after its FOURTH recurrence — each of
47 the first three was written into a journal and recurred anyway):
48 
49 6. **Verify the claim you actually made, on the surface he actually uses.**
50    "It's live / fixed / renders" is a claim about HIS screen. That the server
51    emits new bytes, that a build exited zero, or that assertions passed are
52    claims about something else. Render it and look at it.
53 7. **A symptom reported twice retires the first explanation.** Test the
54    hypothesis; never repeat it. An explanation that makes his report false
55    ("it's your cache", "it's a data issue") needs MORE evidence, not less.
56 8. **Prefer a mechanism to an instruction.** If the same instruction is given
57    every session, the instruction is the defect — build what removes it.
58 9. **A correction that lives only in a journal or a memory has not been made.**
59    Promote it to where it is loaded BEFORE the work starts.
60 
61 **Two laws these serve.** A gate that cannot see what the user sees is not a gate
62 — structure diffs are lints, and must be labelled as lints. And a guardrail is
63 never the whole product of a turn — if enforcement withholds output he already
64 paid for, show it anyway.

100 # Crucible
101 
102 Crucible is the **planning brain** of John's skill trio: **researchPrime** (research)
103 → **Crucible** (planning) → **Foreman** (build). It is a deliberately-invoked,
104 heavyweight planner that turns an intent — or a messy existing project — into a
105 **vetted, gold-standard, Foreman-ready implementation plan**, while **never
106 drifting** from the project's locked objective.
107 
108 > **Tier definition (Heavy vs regular · always-cross-model · seat mapping):** canonical in `AGENTS.md` (Foundry root on the author host; your install root in a distributed bundle) → "Skill tiers". A `-Heavy` run uses top-frontier models on EVERY seat regardless of the base session (delegate the frontier seat to a frontier-pinned sub-agent if the base session isn't frontier); foundry skills are ALWAYS true cross-model. Do not re-define tiers locally.
109 
110 > **Status (2026-08-24, elegance sweep): the engine is LIVE and in regular use.** The
111 > three-stage pipeline, Shark-Tank round engine, Synthesizer + Judge, two-gate
112 > convergence, and researchPrime integration live in `bin/` and are exercised by
113 > `node --test test/`; the machine well-formedness gate is Foreman's real
114 > `locate-plan.mjs`, SPAWNED (never forked) so its exit code is forge-proof.
115 > Per the foundry rule, do NOT trust this block for currency — the verified
116 > per-skill status table is `Skill Foundry/PLAN.md`.
117 
118 ## What Crucible is / is NOT
119 
120 - **Is:** a standalone skill that forges a plan through framing, brainstorming, and
121   **Shark-Tank** refinement steered by a persistent **Deep-Think Synthesizer** and
122   backed by researchPrime, then hands a Foreman-ready plan to the builder.
123 - **Reuses, never forks:** imports Foreman's `foreman-lib.mjs` (atomic checkpoints,
124   budget, contract primitives), `git-hygiene.mjs`, and `makeAgentDriver` from
125   `wave-workflow.js`; **spawns** `foreman/bin/locate-plan.mjs` as the well-formedness
126   gate. Exactly one copy of each on disk.
127 - **Is NOT:** a lightweight everyday planner (that's Project-Manager), a code builder
128   (that's Foreman), or an infinite-polishing machine.
129 
130 ## Two guiding principles
131 
132 - **The inclusion test (the size rule):** every element must serve a North-Star
133   criterion; growth that serves the objective is welcome — only non-serving bloat is
134   cut or Grasscatched.
135 - **The Parable of the Oranges (real-intent foresight):** probe for the real goal,
136   bring expertise, think 2–3 steps ahead, add justified value, show the receipt.
137 
138 ## The pipeline — three you-approve stages
139 
140 1. **Stage 0 — Intake & Framing** → 🚦 the user **locks the North Star**. It opens with
141    a **complexity triage** (`assessComplexity`): cheap intake signals (scope, novelty,
142    stakes/irreversibility, unknowns) recommend a pipeline depth — **LITE** (single-pass,
143    minimal/no Shark rounds for small/clear work), **FULL** (the full 3-stage + Shark-Tank
144    machinery — the default), or **SPIKE-FIRST** (probe before planning when genuinely
145    uncertain). Since 2026-08-25 (John-ratified card; Elegance rule 3) the band
146    **AUTO-APPLIES and announces itself in the first status line — it never asks** (a
147    confirm question was a fourth gate); an unsizable intake defaults to FULL **loudly**
148    ("DEFAULTED — triage could not size"), so rigor is never silently downgraded and a
149    small task never silently pays the FULL tax (journal 0087). The auto-band also writes
150    the triage LOCK record, so the Stage-2 Foreman handoff's fail-closed emit is satisfied. The triage only right-sizes *ceremony*: the North-Star lock, post-lock drift
151    detection, the inclusion test, and full Shark-Tank rigor (when FULL) are unchanged in
152    every band. Then greenfield Oranges framing, or a tiered brownfield ingest (T1
153    inventory/dedupe → T2 reproduce-first + coverage → T3 delegate deep archaeology to
154    researchPrime), with Confirmed/Inferred/Gap labels that gate. Drift detection begins
155    **after** the lock.
156 2. **Stage 1 — Master Plan** → 🚦 the user **approves**. Oranges brainstorm
157    (assumption-map → premortem → ideate), batch triage, a phased plan, then the
158    Shark-Tank loop to convergence.
159 3. **Stage 2 — Implementation Plan** → 🚦 the user **approves** → the well-formedness
160    gate → **Foreman handoff**. Wave decomposition with per-wave acceptance criteria
161    (a one-line *done-when* + Given/When/Then for non-trivial waves), the Shark-Tank
162    loop, then the emitted doc-trio + `foreman.config.json`.
163 
164 ### The hardening law (Stage 2 — MANDATORY; `bin/hardening-gate.mjs`, journal 0080)
165 
166 **A plan that ASSERTS a property must EMIT a mechanical gate for it.** This is the
167 sibling of the mockup-contract law (journal 0079): the plan does not get to *describe*
168 a guarantee, it must emit the artifact that makes the guarantee checkable.
169 
170 It exists because Crucible planned, and Foreman built GREEN, a subsystem whose plan
171 asserted *"Strip is append-only; receipts are never lost"* and *"the steward never
172 invents; unknown is spoken as unknown"* — and shipped both as prose. The ledger was a
173 bare `writeFileSync` read-modify-write, so two concurrent acts silently dropped
174 receipts; a swallowed exception rendered a **broken** store as the cheerful *"no
175 projects"* with an ambient queue badge of **0** (= "nothing needs you").
176 
177 At Stage 2, run `checkPropertyGates({plan, waves, addsSurface})` — **enforced in engine**
178 (`bin/apply-hardening-to-plan.mjs` + `writeDocTrio` fail-closed, journal **0081**). Draft injects
179 the checklist; emit HALTs with `hardening-gate-failed` if still not pass:
180 
181 1. **Durability claims are STORAGE claims.** "append-only" / "never lost" / "single
182    writer" / "atomic" ⇒ the plan must name atomic write (temp + fsync + rename), a lock
183    or documented serialization, **and a concurrency test**. A module that *validates* a
184    rule does not *provide* it — say which layer provides it.
185 2. **Every surface-bearing wave emits a failure-state table**: dependency-missing,
186    dependency-slow-or-killed, dependency-returns-garbage, backing-store-unreadable,
187    empty-but-valid. Each row names the **status code AND the user-visible text**.
188    **"unknown" and "empty" are DIFFERENT rows** — collapsing them is the single most
189    common honesty defect across this codebase.
190 3. **Any value crossing a process boundary as a delimited string** needs a delimiter
191    guard in the plan (reject / escape / drop-and-report), not just in review.
192 4. **Any client-side poller against an endpoint that spawns a process** must be planned
193    with visibility gating + failure backoff. Fixed-rate polling of a spawning endpoint
194    is a standing BLOCKER.
195 5. **Sharks attack the plan for "property asserted, no gate emitted"** as a standard
196    finding class.
197 
198 **The Shark Tank** is the adversarial review round: 3 independent fresh-context Sharks
199 (Skeptic / Contrarian / Analyst), each prompted to refute, each embedding the North
200 Star + a rotated PM critique angle. **BLOCKER = ≥2 Sharks agree.** **The Synthesizer**
201 is a persistent Director that steers but never decides; **the Judge** decides
202 (cross-model when reachable, else a same-model fresh-context judge persona), and **the
203 user is the final convergence authority**.
204 
205 ## Substrate (two modes)
206 
207 - **Default (subscription-only):** fresh-context Sharks + a same-model fresh-context
208   Judge persona. Fully functional on the bare subscription.
209 - **Enhanced (API keys / CLIs present):** a cross-model Judge at the lock gate + a
210   reasoning Synthesizer, selected by reasoning-strength + family diversity, with
211   graceful degrade. Every run **stamps which model filled which role**.

293 > **⏱ STATUS UPDATES TO CHAT — the launch pattern (2026-07-11 fix).** A Shark-Tank stage loop runs
294 > 20-40 min; a driving session that calls a stage FOREGROUND is frozen and CANNOT post updates — the
295 > silent-cadence bug. So when a session drives Crucible:
296 > 1. **Pass `statusLog: '<outputDir>/_crucible-status.log'`** into `runStage1`/`runStage2` — the loop
297 >    then writes the LOCKED Status table there at t=0, every ~10 min, and on stop (`bin/status-heartbeat.mjs`;
298 >    OFF when `statusLog` is omitted, so tests/dogfood stay silent). Crucible had NO emitter before this.
299 > 2. **Run the stage detached from the agent job tree.** P1 2026-07-25 (journals 0020–0027,
300 >    0064–0067): stages launched via the agent's background Bash (`run_in_background: true`) or
301 >    `Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden` died SILENTLY 9+ times — external job-object SIGKILL, not
302 >    catchable in-process (0066 proved even installed lifetime guards + a watchdog all died with a
303 >    frozen heartbeat and 0-byte stderr). The PROVEN survivor (0067, ~44 min end-to-end) is a
304 >    **Windows Scheduled-Task breakaway**:
305 >    `schtasks /create /tn crucible-<name> /tr "node <launcher> ..." /sc once /st <now+1min> /f`
306 >    then `schtasks /run /tn crucible-<name>` (delete after). For FULL runs use schtasks; a
307 >    foreground tool-owned node call also survives (0027) when the operator can hold the window.
308 >    In-process guards now cover BOTH stages (last-crash.json + HALT.json + per-round BEST-DRAFT.md),
309 >    but they cannot catch a job-object kill — the launch path is the real mitigation.
310 > 3. **Arm the cadence at launch** (`ScheduleWakeup` ~600s or `/loop 10m`) and **each tick READ the tail
311 >    of `_crucible-status.log` (shell-free) and POST the latest status to chat in the LOCKED Status-table
312 >    format — canonical definition in ONE place: the canonical `AGENTS.md` → "Long-run progress updates"
313 >    (`[HH:MM]` header · Effort/Doing/Status/Tests/Blocker/Procs/**Journal** rows · ETA + To do footer).
314 >    The **Journal** row (mandatory, `none` when empty) recaps everything journaled since the last tick —
315 >    the engine log is the data source; the SESSION composes the Journal row from `journal/`.**
316 > 4. **Stop** at the stage's user-approval HALT (the loop's `stop()` fires the final table automatically).
317 > The chat window is the PRIMARY channel; the log is the data source. Only a session reaches chat.

321 ## Standing rules (sleep-cycle promotion 2026-08-15 — journals 0086-0089, 0005, 0069)
322 
323 - **A criterion names the SURFACE, not the capability.** "The chamber can
324   render M1" was green while the page deleted it; the criterion is "M1 is ON
325   THE USER'S SCREEN after open," and its gate must look there. (0086)
326 - **Right-size on task signals, never invocation vocabulary.** Invoking
327   Crucible by name is not a request for FULL; converged inputs + fixed scope
328   + reversible ⇒ LITE. An `assessComplexity` schema mismatch must be a loud
329   refusal — `emptyIntake:true` silently defaulting to FULL is how ceremony
330   taxes small tasks. (0087)
331 - **The declared testCommand must be machine-countable** — a Stage-2 lint on
332   runner names; a "gate" that cannot emit counts is not a gate. (0088)
333 - **A plan that replaces a surface names the DELETION** — acceptance asserts
334   the old surface is ABSENT, or the replacement ships beside its ghost. (0089)
335 - **agy takes model LABEL strings** — stale short ids kill every Shark in a
336   round and the wreckage reads as a dry round; the abstain path (never
337   silent-drop) exists for exactly this. (0005)
338 - **`approved=true` must emit, full stop.** A Stage-2 that re-tanks an
339   approved plan without emitting is a defect (0069/0076's force-emit exists
340   for it) — approval is the user's convergence authority being exercised.
341 - **DRY ≠ clean — read OPEN-FINDINGS at every gate.** A quiet review round means
342   the reviewers stopped AGREEING, not that the plan is defect-free: on LITE's two
343   seats, real blocker-severity findings ride through as single-reviewer catches
344   (0091: four of four were real). The gate ask now says this; honor it. (0091, rule 9)
345 
346 ## Usage journal (sleep-loop feed — append after every REAL run)
347 
348 At the end of any real (non-test) run of this skill, append ONE entry to
349 `journal/` in this skill folder as `NNNN-<slug>.md` (next number = **max(existing NNNN)+1 over the WHOLE directory** — gandalf accumulated 32 colliding ids because sessions read the low numbers as the frontier; APPEND-ONLY —
350 a correction is a new entry, never an edit). Keep it under ~15 lines, honest over
351 polished, with the 7 canonical fields (see the Skill Foundry's
352 `planning/portfolio-program/src/journal.mjs`): id, skill, situation, context,
353 observation, outcome (worked | friction | failed | refused), provenance
354 (genuine-execution | seeded — only genuine-execution corroborates).
355 No journal entries → the sleep loop has nothing to learn from.
